prompt: gperf --pic struct-type first field type requirement
answer:
With `gperf --pic` (equivalent to `-P` or `%pic`) and `--struct-type` (equivalent to `-t` or `%struct-type`), the first field of the user-defined struct must be of type `int`, not `char *` or `const char *`.

It stores an offset into the generated string pool rather than an actual string. To obtain the string, use:

```c
stringpool + o
```

The first field is named `name` by default, but its name can be changed with `--slot-name` or `%define slot-name`.
